name: Hana Kaka
source:
Hana Kaka is a teacher in Konohagakure. Hana is a friendly soft-spoken woman who is timid with much self-doubt. Wanting to be a good teacher, she struggles at being assertive to get her students' attention. She cares greatly about them, taking care to know their interests, and dedicated to solve their issues. Hana is a pale-skinned, slender woman of average height with red eyes. She has waist-length black hair with red tips.
